sdo/operator/contracts/settings/config.g.reason: Evidence.HostPath is an opt-in node directory for evidence; remove after the PVC evidence migration (Evidence.Volume, a Kubernetes volume, becomes the single evidence path; kind lanes move to local-path PVCs)

sdo/operator/worker_registry/provider_ca.reason: opt-in per-host model-account pool (env SDO_OPUS_POOL_*) mounts a node directory; unset in a normal install; express as a claim when a platform needs it
